title: Experiential / gradient football court

location.series: Elvis Dinh / Instagram brand design system / project year 2022

slide_intent: Extend an identity across an environment so participants encounter the brand through activity.
strategic_value: A continuous color field can make an Instagram event recognizable in both wide views and participant photographs.
demonstration: A wide view shows a gradient football court, white playing lines, central partner mark and seating beneath the Eiffel Tower.
practical_value: Assess the field, signage and partner marks together when reviewing an event identity.

content_islands.name: Court field
content_islands.spec: Carry the gradient across the playing surface while keeping white sport markings legible.

content_islands.name: Venue surroundings
content_islands.spec: Retain stands, perimeter signs and the skyline to establish the event scale.

reference_purposes.Application: The photo demonstrates brand color applied across a sports environment.
reference_purposes.Expression: The gradient turns the playing field into a continuous brand-colored surface.

ingredient.name: Environmental gradient
ingredient.role: Connect activity and setting with the brand palette.
ingredient.application: Apply the gradient across the court while keeping white sport markings and partner identification visible, as shown.
ingredient.scope: This photographed football activation; no general specification for sports surfaces is supplied.
